summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by CNH Capital Receivables LLC and CNH Equipment Trust 2026-B regarding a public issuance of asset-backed notes (Classes A-1 through A-4) totaling approximately $908 million. The notes are secured by equipment loan receivables, issued under an existing shelf registration (SF-3). Lead managers include Wells Fargo, Rabo Securities, RBC, and SMBC Nikko. The filing satisfies contractual and disclosure requirements for a securitization transaction. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or going-private is involved. This is a standard ABS shelf takedown with no corporate control change or strategic reconfiguration.
